title: Phases
description: Array of phase records. One entry per phase across the project's lifetime. Lives at .state/phases.json.

id.description: Phase number. Unique within the file.

regime.description: Work regime. 'build' uses step-budget execution; 'refine' uses time-budget (see project.json budget_type); 'explore' is open-ended investigation.

dependencies.description: Names of other modules this phase's module depends on. Empty array means leaf module. Non-empty triggers dependency-probe (in plan) and integration-check (in close) conditional sections.

status.description: Phase status. Binary: pending = not yet completed; complete = closed (audit gate set). Catches typos that would make the phase invisible to summary queries.
